mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vladimir gains 1 Ability Power for every @HPforAP@ bonus Health. He also gains @APRatioBonusHP@ max Health per 1 Ability Power.

Vladimir gains 1 Ability Power for every @HPforAP@ bonus Health. He also gains @APRatioBonusHP@ max Health per 1 Ability Power.

Bonus Ability Power: @ApproximateAPBonusAvoidingRecursion@
Bonus Health: @ApproximateHPBonusAvoidingRecursion@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tides of Blood</titleLeft><mainText>Vladimir is channeling his health into a blood reservoir which, when unleashed, will deal damage in an area around him and slow units if fully charged.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keyCost: Channeling Cost <font color='#CC3300'>@MaxHealthCost@% of max Health (@ChargeHealthTooltip@)</font>
mLocKeys.keySummary: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to @ChargeHealthTooltip@ Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%.

Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between @MinDamageTooltip@ and @MaxDamageTooltip@ magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by @SlowPercent@% for 0.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability releases automatically after @MaxChannelTime@ seconds.
Enemies can be hit by multiple blood missiles, but take no damage after the first.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tides of Blood</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by a fully charged Tides of Blood.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take @DamageAmp@% increased damage from all sources for @Duration@ seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to all infected targets. Vladimir restores <healing>@Damage@ Health</healing> if he hits a champion, and restores an additional <healing>@SecondaryHealingTooltip@ Health</healing> for each champion beyond the first.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Hemoplague</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will take additional damage from all sources until Hemoplague detonates.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing @BaseDamageTooltip@ magic damage and restoring @BaseHealTooltip@ Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains @MovementSpeedOnQ2@% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for @FrenzyDuration@ seconds.

The empowered version of this Ability deals @EmpoweredDamageTooltip@ magic damage instead and restores an additional @EmpoweredHealTooltip@ plus @EmpoweredHealPercentTooltip@ missing Health.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Transfusion</titleLeft><mainText>Vladimir's bloodthirst grows as he casts Transfusion, eventually sending him into a frenzy and empowering his next Transfusion. </mainText>
<titleLeft>Crimson Rush</titleLeft><mainText>Vladimir is briefly hasted and, while this buff persists, his next Transfusion will deal increased damage and healing.</mainText>

<titleLeft>Sanguine Pool</titleLeft><mainText>Vladimir is untargetable, slowing and siphoning life from enemies above him for a short duration.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining @HasteBoost*100@% decaying Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@%.

Vladimir deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and restores @TotalHeal@ Health per enemy over the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
This Ability can be used while charging Tides of Blood.
Vladimir can't Attack or use other Abilities while inside the pool.
Healing is @MinionHealingMod*100@% effective against minions.
Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.
Ghosted units can pass through other units.
